lines.say: This one rule decides if you keep growing. Progressive overload.
Your body adapts to what you ask of it.
Lift the same weight for the same reps forever, and the growth signal fades.
So, little by little, you have to ask for more.
Add a little weight, or add a rep or two.
In one study, adding reps worked about as well as adding weight for growth.
Simple method: pick a rep range, like eight to twelve. Hit twelve on every set? Add weight and start again at eight.
And write your workouts down, so you know what to beat.
Next: can you build muscle and lose fat at the same time?
